item.title: Add a JSON API to Any Static Site Generator
item.description:
Back in 2015 I wrote about adding a JSON API to my Jekyll blog. The idea was that if Jekyll can spit out HTML from Liquid templates, it can spit out JSON too. I got it working, but it involved manually comma-separating arrays with forloop.last checks, nil guards for empty tags, and a Gulp task to copy posts into a separate API directory. It worked but it wasn’t pretty.

This blog runs on Hugo now. Hugo has a built-in feature for exactly this kind of thing and it makes the whole process much cleaner. So I figured I would revisit the idea.
